scripts.depcruise: depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.json src test next.config.ts playwright.config.ts vitest.config.ts
scripts.start: cp -R .next/static .next/standalone/apps/backoffice/.next/ && (test ! -d public || cp -R public .next/standalone/apps/backoffice/) && PORT=3001 node .next/standalone/apps/backoffice/server.js
scripts.test:changed: if git rev-parse --quiet --verify origin/main > /dev/null && git diff --quiet "$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)" -- pnpm-lock.yaml pnpm-workspace.yaml "*package.json" "*tsconfig.json" .husky; then vitest run --changed origin/main --passWithNoTests; else vitest run --passWithNoTests; fi
